description: Complete the CortexPlus connection with the 6-digit code the user received by email after signup. Ask the user for the code, then call this tool with the same email used in signup; never guess or invent the code. The response includes an API key that the AI platform should save in its CortexPlus connector configuration.

client.description: The name of the AI platform you are running on, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor.

email.description: The email address used in signup.

key.description: The 6-digit code from the CortexPlus email.

name: connect
